description: Static, version-agnostic config for the unified surgical-lineage merge pipeline. Per-run inputs (expansion, manifests, version) are passed as args; this file holds only stable structure. Adding a new merge destination = one data edit to modules.route_map, never a code copy.

component_report._comment: single_component was DEMOTED from a blocking invariant to a reported metric (V17-INVARIANT). It was being satisfied only by miscoded institution->person direct_training edges acting as sole bridges for small islands — edges that actually encode degree attainment or, in the Safar case, training in another specialty — so enforcing connectivity created standing pressure to keep or author false edges. Connectivity is now REPORTED with a threshold alert, never blocking. Retuned by V17-B3, whose deletion of the JHH Dept of Surgery -> Peter Safar direct_training edge (anesthesiology, failed content-match, retired institution-endpoint class) intentionally stranded the critical-care island — the demotion working as designed. Post-V17-B3 steady state: 6 components (giant 437 + five honest islands: critical care 4 [Peter Safar, Baltimore City Hospital Intensive Care Unit, Society of Critical Care Medicine, William Shoemaker], Yale 3, pre-Halsted New York 3 [John Sheldon, Richard Bayley, Wright Post], ABEA 2, Society of University Surgeons 2), largest island 4.
